title: John Rush's 2023 recap: idea-to-revenue in 13 steps, what growth worked and failed
summary: A newsletter roundup of John Rush's X and LinkedIn posts. It gives his 13-step idea-to-revenue method (SEO and social validation and a waitlist before coding), his 2023 growth results (social media worked; partners, ads, outreach and hiring a marketer failed), and his plan to launch 1000 products on a SaaS OS.

principles.text: Validate before coding: check SEO potential, pick the least competitive niche, get social validation, and build a waitlist first.
principles.quote: 2. SEO potential 3. Pick least Competitive 4. Social Validation 5. Waitlist 6. Organic Promo 7. Paid Promo 8. Directories & SEO 9. Is there traction? 10. Coding MVP

principles.text: Code the MVP only after traction shows up, then turn the coding itself into marketing and iterate before the public launch.
principles.quote: 9. Is there traction? 10. Coding MVP 11. Turn Coding Into Marketing 12. iterate 13. Public Launch

principles.text: Social media was the growth channel that worked for him in 2023; the paid and outsourced channels failed.
principles.quote: Failed - Partners - Newsletter Ads - Podcasts - Outreach - Google/FB/Twitter ads - Hiring a marketing person - Paying influencers Worked - Social Media

principles.text: Share your learnings in public; learning from other bootstrapped founders and then publishing your own lessons compounds.
principles.quote: They’ve inspired me to share all my learnings in public too.

principles.text: He commits to shipping many products on one shared platform rather than a single product, aiming for 1000 by the end of 2025.
principles.quote: By the end of 2025, I’ll launch 1000 products. These products are going to run on a new SaaS OS.
